briefdescription.para: C++ source file with implementations for the µTest++ runner options.

detaileddescription.para: This source file contains the command-line parser of the µTest++ framework, implemented by the runner_options constructor taking the main() arguments, and the recording of the errors it finds.
All definitions reside within the micro_os_plus::micro_test_plus namespace, ensuring clear separation from user code and minimising the risk of naming conflicts.
This file must be included when building the µTest++ library.
